_comment: Feature 8: mood-driven delivery.  Per-mood TTS speed, a spoken interjection on the first line of a reply, and an optional fallback gesture.  speed = multiplier on voice_speed (clamped 0.5-2.0 overall).  interjections = short spoken lead-ins, at most one per reply and at most one every cooldown_turns replies (chance = probability per eligible reply).  gesture = one of body_actions.json's enabled gestures (nod/shake/tilt), or null; it only fires when the reply itself emitted no gesture/wink tag.  Set enabled:false to disable everything.
